synopsis: The ending, written twice. On main Ysoly Tamm speaks the fourth proviso's requirement with the tile whole in her hand: the season clock starts, the Wardenry must appoint a surveyor, and the only one inside three hundred and eighty-five miles is the man whose finding they are burying. She wins the thing she asked for and it costs her the Road, and Sabra Onn tells her so in front of forty acres of glasswort. The alternate ending is preserved on the branch `salt-and-ash`, where the clay lets go a half-second before she speaks and the seal holds as Ferrant's has for fourteen years.
title: The Far Side
